Confirm four-layer capability, component availability and through-hole assembly before ordering. This is a custom manufacturing service, not a ready-made Robbi board; the listing price is not the completed-board price. Includes motor driver, amplifier, IMU and power circuitry; do not double-buy breakout boards.

selection: 1 board  •  Wi-Fi  •  Header already soldered
notes: The exact Zero 2 W model, with Wi-Fi and the 40-pin GPIO header already installed and soldered. Ask for 已焊接排针; a loose header in the box is not enough. Avoid: The older Zero W / Zero WH, an unsoldered board, or a listing labelled only “Zero 2” without confirmation of Wi-Fi and the exact model.

selection: 32 GB minimum  •  64 or 128 GB recommended  •  A1 or A2  •  Class 10 / UHS-I
notes: Choose a high-quality microSD card from a reputable seller: at least 32 GB, preferably 64 or 128 GB. No particular brand is required. The linked card is an example; choose the capacity you want. An SD adapter is optional for your computer. Avoid full-size SD cards, an empty adapter and suspiciously cheap counterfeits.

selection: 2 matching motors  •  3 V  •  75 RPM  •  Encoders
notes: Select “3V75RPM”. Buy two identical N20 / JGA12-N20 units with rear encoder boards. Confirm matching encoder cables are included. Avoid: Plain N20 motors without encoders; 6 V or 12 V versions; 750 RPM, 150 RPM or another speed.

selection: MR128ZZ  •  8 mm bore  •  12 mm outside  •  3.5 mm thick
notes: Select “MR128ZZ 8x12x3.5mm”. Check all three dimensions: 8 mm inner diameter, 12 mm outer diameter and 3.5 mm width. The linked listing sells a 10-piece pack; use the assembly instructions for the number needed. Avoid: MR128-2.5 (only 2.5 mm thick), MR148ZZ (14 mm outside), open or rubber-sealed variants, or flanged bearings in place of this plain MR128ZZ.

selection: 1 module  •  Select TOF400C-VL53L1
notes: Choose “TOF400C-VL53L1”. Look for the TOF400C-VL53L1X board marking. Match its outline, mounting holes and pin labels; check whether headers arrive soldered. Avoid: TOF050C / VL6180 or TOF200C / VL53L0X. Another VL53L1X module can have a different board shape and pinout.

selection: 1 display  •  1.69 inch  •  240 × 280  •  8 pins
notes: Select “1.69 Inch”. Look for the eight-pin SPI board, ST7789-family controller and 240(RGB) × 280 marking on the display board. Avoid: 1.54-inch or 1.9-inch variants; 240 × 240 or 240 × 320 panels; a different pin count or interface. Ignore the listing’s incorrect automatic 320 × 240 summary.

selection: 1 camera  •  IMX219  •  160° lens (second option)  •  CSI
notes: The linked listing’s 160° option was recommended (reported as the second option). Before ordering, confirm it uses an IMX219 sensor and a 15-pin camera connector; check board size, mounting holes and lens clearance against the printed mount. Use the separate 22-to-15-pin Pi Zero camera ribbon. Avoid: OV5647 / 5 MP cameras, narrow-angle lenses, USB webcams or bulky IR assemblies that do not fit the mount.

selection: 1 speaker  •  20 mm diameter  •  8 Ω / 8R  •  0.5 W
notes: Select “20mm”, and verify 8R / 8 Ω and 0.5 W. Prefer attached leads; check that the plug matches the build or can be reterminated. Avoid: 23 / 28 / 30 / 36 mm or larger versions, 4 Ω speakers, buzzers or powered USB speakers.

selection: Single cell with wires; 76 x 21 x 18.4 mm empty; 20.4 mm loaded height
notes: October CAD holder envelope. Trial-fit actual holder, loaded cell, leads and both panels. Glue empty holder after checks; central hole stays unused. Actual spring/contact clearance unverified.

selection: 1 cell  •  About 3000 mAh  •  Genuine high-drain Li-ion
notes: A traceable genuine single 18650 Li-ion cell with dimensions, charge/discharge limits and protection compatible with the approved power circuit. Molicel P30B is a reference example, not an instruction to fit an unprotected cell to an unverified circuit. Avoid: Anonymous cells with implausible capacity labels, reclaimed cells, 21700 / 14500 sizes or LiFePO₄. A longer protected/button-top cell may not fit.

selection: 1 charger  •  External slot charger  •  USB-C input
notes: A USB-C charger for 3.6 / 3.7 V Li-ion 18650 cells, charging to 4.2 V. Check the actual input socket and select a charge current within the cell manufacturer’s limit; the linked XTAR ANT MC1 Plus is a USB-C reference example. Avoid: An older micro-USB version, a bare TP4056 board, an empty holder, or a charger intended only for NiMH or 1.5 V batteries.

selection: 1 adapter  •  LEFT  •  Micro-USB male → USB-A female
notes: Choose “Left” in the original listing. It must support OTG and data. For other sellers, check that the plug direction leaves the microphone inside the body with the USB data port accessible. Avoid: “Right”, USB-C, mini-USB or charge-only adapters. Left/right naming can vary between sellers.

selection: 1 microphone  •  USB-A  •  Built-in microphone
notes: A complete microphone dongle with driver-free USB Audio / Linux / Raspberry Pi compatibility. Match the small physical size shown. Avoid: A USB Bluetooth receiver, a sound card with only empty audio sockets, a 3.5 mm-only mic, or an I²S microphone breakout.

selection: 1 cable  •  VH series  •  3.96 mm pitch  •  2P
notes: Select “2P”. Buy the VH3.96 housing with crimped wires attached; the linked listing offers 20 cm leads. Check the latch, mating socket and polarity against the PCB. Required cable end is FEMALE, with recessed socket contacts and no exposed pins. Verify polarity with a meter; wire colour alone is insufficient. Avoid: 3P–10P, a bare housing, or a PCB header alone. PH2.0, XH2.50 / 2.54 and other “JST 2-pin” families are not interchangeable.

selection: M2 internal thread  •  Outside size must match the model
notes: M2 inserts intended for heat installation. Match outer diameter, length and quantity to the printed parts. The linked assortment contains several sizes, including M2. Avoid: M2.5 / M3 inserts, ordinary hex nuts or wood inserts. “M2” specifies only the thread; it does not guarantee the outside dimensions fit.

selection: 4 x M2x20; 1 x M2x10; 1 x M2x6 socket heads; 6 AF4 x 1.6 nuts
notes: October CAD specification, not physically validated. Four compact OD4.5 x 0.3 washers for board stack; none on clip. Unchanged fixings and insert dimensions still need confirmation. Check actual assortment contents; pack count is not build quantity.

notes: October CAD head specification is 12 mm under head, replacing old 14 mm buying selection. Check listing offers correct option and source nuts/washers separately if needed. Physical fit unverified; no substitution by pack size or screw force.

selection: F–F  •  Sockets at both ends  •  2.54 mm headers
notes: Choose F-F / Female-Female / 母对母. Both ends must have sockets. Select a length and wire count that suit the wiring route without tension. Avoid: M-M / 公对公 or M-F / 公对母. The listing’s default selection may be the wrong type.

part: 16 cm Pi Zero camera adapter ribbon
selection: 16 cm; 22-pin / 0.5 mm pitch to 15-pin / 1.0 mm pitch
notes: Use the 16 cm Pi Zero camera adapter ribbon with a 22-pin narrow end and a 15-pin wide end. Check both connector widths and contact orientation; do not buy 15-to-15 or 22-to-22 by mistake. Avoid: A different length without checking the fit. Confirm that the selected listing option is 16 cm.

selection: Small assortment / one roll  •  Electrical insulation
notes: Heat-shrink sizes that fit over the joints and shrink snugly, or tape explicitly rated for electrical insulation. No particular brand is required. Avoid: Packing tape, masking tape, conductive copper tape, or tubing too large to grip after shrinking.

selection: Use an existing setup or buy one  •  Electronics soldering
notes: A temperature-controlled iron, suitable tip, stand, solder wire and electronics flux. Choose the correct local mains plug and input voltage. Avoid: 110 V-only equipment, plumbing acid flux, a welding machine, or a hot-air-only tool in place of an electronics soldering iron.

selection: 1 set  •  Hex H1.5 / H2.0 / H2.5  •  Small Phillips bits
notes: Check the bit list includes H1.5 and H2.5 hex bits: the DIN 912 socket-head screws shown use 1.5 mm hex for M2 and 2.5 mm for M3. H2.0 and small Phillips bits make the set more versatile. Match the bit to the actual screw head. Avoid: Phillips-only or Torx-only sets, kits missing the small hex sizes, or a large powered driver that can strip these tiny screws.

selection: Access to a glue gun  •  Matching glue sticks
notes: Glue sticks whose diameter matches the gun. If buying a mains gun, choose a plug and voltage suitable for your local mains supply. Check whether sticks are included. Avoid: Sticks in the wrong diameter, or ordering only a gun when you also need glue. Do not substitute superglue or conductive adhesive without checking the assembly.

selection: One complete set of Robbi’s printed parts  •  Custom quote required
notes: Custom printing service reference. Send the confirmed printable parts, quantities, scale, material and settings for a quote. Confirm process and tolerances before ordering; the displayed listing price is not a full Robbi print set. Do not send the whole assembly STL as a single print. Avoid resized parts, a random robot shell or an incomplete print order.
